data.description:
## Context / Problem

`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/passes.py:562-593::pass4_coach` has only three direct unit-test callers; commit `52d7a3dc16810` records it as unit-test-only after workflow cutover. `src/rebar/llm/workflow/executor.py:335-352::_guard_passes` has only `test_prior_art_hardening.py:64-65` callers; the v2 runtime uses `workflow/interpreter.py:284-305::_guard_scoped`.

## Approach

First migrate direct tests, inventories, and maintained documentation to workflow operations/shared `review_kernel.coach` and interpreter-level `_guard_scoped` behavior. Preserve semantic behavior, then delete both superseded helpers.

## Scope

- `llm/plan_review/passes.py`
- `llm/workflow/executor.py` and interpreter
- plan-review workflow YAML, inventories/docs, and direct tests

## Testing

Cover coach move applicability, decision inclusion, deterministic rendering, model selection, clean-plan no-call behavior, and fail-closed frame-scoped guards.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Tests and maintained material name workflow operations/shared `review_kernel.coach` as the coach owner.
- [ ] `pass4_coach` is removed after its three direct test consumers migrate.
- [ ] The fail-closed bare-string guard oracle executes through `_guard_scoped` or interpreter-level behavior before `_guard_passes` is removed.
- [ ] Coach rendering/model-selection/no-call behavior and scoped guard failure behavior remain covered.
- [ ] Focused workflow and plan-review suites pass.
data.title: Retire superseded LLM workflow helpers after test migration
